brief:
Israeli occupation authorities have ordered the uprooting of olive trees covering 56 dunams in the village of Kafr Malik, the Ma'an news agency reported. The directive represents another instance of land-use restrictions imposed on Palestinian agricultural areas under Israeli control.

The village of Kafr Malik, located in the central West Bank, has faced repeated orders affecting its farming operations. Olive cultivation forms a significant part of the local economy in the area.
title: Israel orders uprooting of olive trees across 56 dunams in Kafr Malik
